name: Barb Schmidt
reason: No site of her own and work framed around mental health: two web searches found only Peaceful Mind Peaceful Life, the nonprofit she co-founded with her daughter Michelle Maros, whose site (read 6 Nov 2026) presents its mission as 'enhancing mental health' through corporate and university workshops, a podcast and a coming 'Emotional Well-being Toolkit'; her newsletter is on Substack (off limits). An organisation with mental-health framing rather than a personal spiritual-teaching listing.
